title: Parker as first alto in the section, never recorded
summary: He played the lead part like a solo, giving the saxes a free, unwritten sound, but he was never recorded in a section.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: The other thing that they missed out on completely with Charlie Parker, was Charlie Parker playing the first alto saxophone in the reed section, which was something that I've never heard anything like it before or afterwards. Because he played the first sax part just like he played a solo. It was

free, and the saxophone players had a tendency to play just like him. And it just brought about an entirely different kind of a sound. It didn't sound like they were reading at all. I think they recorded Charlie Parker with little groups, with big bands, they recorded him with strings and all of that. But never him playing in section. I think that was a big loss.
